title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 20: Witness

scenes.say: A young soldier home from overseas finds Ali after a talk.
scenes.visual: a young man in a military jacket waiting near a stage exit, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's not sleeping. He's drinking. He's thinking dark thoughts.
scenes.visual: an empty bottle on a dark kitchen counter, streetlight through a window, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
two men sitting on a curb at night, one talking, one listening, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I've been where you are, he says. And there's a way out.
scenes.visual: two silhouettes against the glow of a city at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He drives the kid to the VA himself the next morning.
scenes.visual: a car pulling into a veterans center parking lot at sunrise, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Sits in the waiting room so he doesn't have to sit alone.
scenes.visual: two men sitting side by side in a waiting room, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Being a witness means showing people the other side exists.
scenes.visual: a hallway leading toward a bright open door, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali's story isn't a performance. It's evidence.
scenes.visual: the book Hoodlum Soldier style manuscript on a table, soft light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: If he made it, maybe they can too.
scenes.visual: a young man looking out a window at sunrise, calm, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some people preach hope. Ali lives it out loud.
scenes.visual: a man walking down a city street at dawn, light ahead of him, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty One. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a lighthouse beam cutting through fog, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 20 of 25: Witness. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
